verdict.rationale: dlt provides a declarative REST API source framework for arbitrary/long-tail APIs (dlt-docs-23, dlt-docs-63), plus a low-code OpenAPI-based generator (dlt-init-openapi) that builds a custom pipeline from any OpenAPI 3.x spec without forking dlt itself (dlt-docs-25, dlt-docs-32, dlt-docs-40, dlt-docs-55). This is a first-class, documented, supported workflow (not a fork) with schema inference, incremental loading, and destination flexibility built in (dlt-docs-18, dlt-docs-20, dlt-docs-37). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification specifically of building a custom long-tail connector via the OpenAPI generator (community evidence here is about dlt generally, not this specific workflow).
